profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer (iOS) at Acorns
profile.summary:
Acorns leverages my expertise as a Senior Software Engineer to enhance iOS platforms by developing critical tools and infrastructure that empower developers. As part of the Core Client team, we focus on tooling that streamlines processes and elevates the user experience. My technical contributions also include redesigning app interfaces, improving subscription management, and re-architecting the home feed to deliver seamless customer experiences.  

With over five years at Acorns, I’ve led efforts to modernize the registration experience, making the codebase more accessible and experiment-friendly for other developers. Proficient in SwiftUI and system architecture, I bring a balance of innovation and structure to iOS development. My collaborative approach aligns with Acorns’ mission to provide intuitive, customer-focused financial solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (iOS)
positions.description:
Senior iOS developer.
- Currently leading the Core Client team, developing tooling and critical infrastructure for developers.
- On the Core Experience team, delivered key features and enhancements to the customer experience, including: app redesigns, enhancements to subscription management, re-architected home feeds, and many other experiences.
- Worked on the Growth team, owning the registration / onboarding experience. Lead a full rewrite of the registration experience to modernize the code and make it easier for other developers to onboard and introduce experiments to the flow.

projects.title: Hero of Carrota
projects.description: 3D OpenGL project written in C++. Used Artemis Entity System Framework for the base of the game engine. My role: 2D spatial data-structure for optimizing collision detection, collision detection, 1st person camera system, "waves" system for spawning enemies (used JSON data to set speed, timing, health, size, etc), game difficulty balance (designing wave order/difficulty, choosing appropriate health for enemies and damage for weapons), moving skybox to prevent clipping, as well as contributing help to others or building models when needed.

projects.title: Mobile Rig Drilling Display (Capstone)
projects.description: Created a cross-platform (iOS and Android), mobile application to display telemetry data from Scientific Drilling International's equipment in a 3-quarter capstone. The application allowed users to select Well's using SDI's equipment, view a dashboard of updating data, and create historical plots of data for specific curves. The first quarter was devoted to gathering customer requirements and creating a vertical and horizontal prototype of the application. The second quarter was the development phase, where a majority of the functionality was implemented. During this phase, I was responsible for working on the iOS version of the application, using Swift. The final quarter was the deployment phase. During this quarter, we found and fixed bugs for our own project and other teams' and went through multiple release cycles before a final Beta release.
